messages.subject: For Ebban Clause | Sustainability, strategy and mining-customer execution
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Heikkila,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Ebban Clause, Chief Sustainability and Strategy Officer.

Caterpillar's decision to combine sustainability and enterprise strategy reflects an important shift in how mining and industrial customers are evaluating value. Productivity, equipment lifecycle, technology, emissions and stakeholder expectations increasingly sit inside the same commercial decision.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory within a major mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around industrial solar and battery infrastructure and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I would value a conversation about where this operator-side mining perspective might support Caterpillar's sustainability, strategy, customer-value or emerging-market priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
